authoring.provenance: Fresh synthetic policies authored by an assistant agent from the requested domain, without reading application prompts or code, previous holdout sources, previous goldens, previous model outputs, or current model outputs.
authoring.validationType: AI authored and independently AI reviewed; not human bilingual validation

domain.submittedAt: Canonical UTC ISO 8601 millisecond string with years 0000..9999
domain.fees: Fixed USD integer cents; null for rejected attendees
domain.orderedOverrides: First-match only when an ordering is explicitly specified
domain.unsupported: Quotas, external state, arithmetic, unspecified local-time zone, and unspecified overlapping fee priority

evaluationBoundary: Only provider-inputs.json may be supplied as benchmark case material to evaluated models. Goldens, oracle, audit and freeze metadata are evaluator-only.
limitations: Small synthetic benchmark; results do not establish general model or method superiority.
Outcome checks across ages, flags and time partitions are not additional independent policies.
The unresolved cases have no complete deterministic oracle and deliberately raise UnresolvedPolicyError.
